description: This file implements transformation utilities for converting between A2A and OpenAI message formats, managing streaming events, and constructing related event objects within a software system that interfaces with language models and messaging protocols.

classes.name: A2AStreamingContext
classes.description: Holds the streaming context state, including task and context IDs, message input, and accumulated text.

classes.name: A2ACompletionBridgeTransformation
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods to transform messages and create streaming events between A2A and OpenAI formats.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] a2a_message_to_openai_messages( a2a_message: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Converts an A2A message object into OpenAI-formatted messages, mapping roles and extracting text parts.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] openai_response_to_a2a_response( response: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms a ModelResponse object into an A2A send message response, capturing content and constructing message parts.

methods.name: str _get_timestamp()
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in ISO 8601 format with timezone info.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, )
methods.description: Creates an initial task event signaling message creation with status 'submitted'.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_status_update_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, state: str, final: bool = False, message_text: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a status update event indicating working or completed status, with optional message content.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_artifact_update_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, text: str, )
methods.description: Creates an artifact update event containing specific text content.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] openai_chunk_to_a2a_chunk( chunk: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, is_final: bool = False, )
methods.description: Converts a streaming chunk from LiteLLM to an A2A-compatible streaming message (deprecated in streaming context).

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, request_id: str, input_message: Dict[str, Any]):$/

ctags.name: create_status_update_event
ctags.signature: ( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, state: str, final: bool = False, message_text: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.name: openai_chunk_to_a2a_chunk
ctags.signature: ( chunk: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, is_final: bool = False, )
